programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Pogo wants to go skydiving with Newt, but she doesn't want to go. He soon discovers the only thing that can get her to agree: the final sticker for her collection. Then, Pogo gets his hands on Bubbles' mind control chips and picks poor Fuse as the object of his latest experiment! Finally, Pogo convinces the others a monster is on the loose, but it's just another one of his pranks.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The cul-de-sac is dealing with some new arrivals! First, there's an alien invader, in the form of a popcorn-obsessed creature that has cloned itself to look exactly like Newt, who is trapped on its spaceship! Then, Zee has the misfortune of having to babysit his disruptive niece and nephew who seem intent on wrecking both his home and his head! Plus, a pleasant afternoon barbecue takes a turn for the worse for Jeff.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-quiet night in Oddsville! When a power cut strikes, all the Oddbods seek refuge at Fuse's house, ruining his plans to watch the big game. Then, a funky asteroid lands in the cul-de-sac and emits groovy pop music that puts everyone in a dance trance! The chaos continues when one of Newt's eggs gets zapped at the store and hatches into an adorable but monstrously hungry chick!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are learning some important lessons! Fuse is too proud to admit his eyesight is failing, but he must overcome his vanity when his poor vision puts Bubbles in real danger. Then, after being humiliated for his lack of etiquette, Zee gets some help from his pal Jeff. As an expert in social manners, Jeff finds transforming Zee into a fancier Bod to be a real challenge! Plus, Fuse gets a new job as a delivery man.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! First, the perfect snowy day inspires Pogo to pull some pranks, but they go too far and he and Newt come face-to-face with a hungry bear! Then, Jeff is throwing a party to impress some snooty friends, but his high expectations cause his waiter to quit, leaving him in a disaster. The trouble continues when Newt is asked to look after a mystery parcel and can't resist taking a peek inside!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange night for the Oddbods! Slick fancies himself a great dancer, but he's terrible! When he discovers the truth, Jeff is kind enough to offer his services and soon transforms him into quite the mover. Then, Fuse's perfect night's sleep is interrupted by an intruder: a very resilient and resourceful mouse! Who will triumph in this battle of wills? Finally, Slick and Newt go on a date, but things don't go as planned when Newt is infected by a werewolf!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are in a real panic! First, Fuse and Pogo find themselves stranded inside Jeff's house after he goes on holiday. They must find a way to get along until Jeff gets back! Then, Fuse is rescued by Newt from an embarrassing situation and takes it upon himself to repay the debt by becoming her hero. Finally, one of Bubbles' experiments ends up in Pogo's ice cream, and his customers start to experience terrible side effects!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Slick sees Bubbles' talent for invention and decides he wants in on it, too. But after several failures, he takes a shortcut and 'borrows' one of her ideas, to disastrous effect! Then, Pogo makes himself homeless while playing a reckless game and is kindly taken in by Fuse. But it's not long before his prank-playing becomes insufferable. Plus, Bubbles discovers a possibly cursed ancient artifact.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into some magical situations! Finally, Zee accidentally gets on Bubbles' rescue mission to stop a meteor storm and his surprising talent may be just what she needs!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for some technological mayhem with the Oddbods! What's more annoying than Pogo? Another Pogo! programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Pogo finally meets his match when he annoys an equally annoying and determined bird species called a 'Twitcher.' programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big changes! Pogo tries his new hypnosis machine on Jeff, who scoffs at it. But it's not long before Pogo gets Jeff to behave like a dog! programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a very busy day! Zee needs some money, so he does some odd jobs, but his laziness makes him a less-than-ideal employee. programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are taking on some new roles! First, Fuse chops down a tree and finds himself the reluctant parent to a hatchling chick. Will the cute baby bird melt his heart? programme.desc: The Oddbods are making new friends and foes! First, Zee inadvertently picks up a piglet from a nearby farm and quickly forms a strong bond with his new friend. programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! Fuse fires up the BBQ, but an uninvited guest arrives: a teeny-tiny house spider! programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing new challenges! Pogo is shunned by everyone after his latest prank backfires, so he ventures to prove that he's a changed Bod. programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! Ashamed by another angry outburst, Fuse decides to reinvent himself as a brand new, calmer Oddbod. How will the others take to this new character? programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Zee is zapped by an impatient Bubbles who is tired of his sluggishness. programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a tough day! It's Jeff's birthday, and everyone is in party mode except Jeff. His strict rules and regulations threaten to derail his own celebrations! programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods have some new goals! After a sequence of annoying events, Jeff decides he's had enough and is moving out! The others rally together to convince him to stay. Finally, Zee enters a road endurance race to win a trophy that looks like a gigantic hot dog!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for a competitive day with the Oddbods! Then, Jeff isn't the most athletic, and when he gets roped into a sports game against some overly competitive Greybods, he finds he's out of his depth. programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! Newt, Jeff and Pogo all go out for the perfect picnic, except each has a separate idea of what that entails! programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a wild day! An incident with Newt and some local birds causes the accidental launch of Bubbles' rocket into space with the birds inside! programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! After being caught in one of Bubbles' experiments, Fuse and Newt accidentally switch bodies! programme.desc: The Oddbods are in for some big surprises! Newt discovers a treasure map that leads to a valuable find, but it's buried under Jeff's pristine lawn! A battle of wits begins! programme.title: Oddbods

programme.desc: The Oddbods are on the move! When modifications to Fuse's truck cause it to develop a mind of its own and turn truly monstrous, he must take back control to protect his friends. programme.desc: After being disappointed multiple times, Risya is introduced by a friend to Andy, a nerdy young man. They fall in love but in actuality, Andy is a boyfriend from 'hell'!

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Hospitality
programme.desc: A woman with a checkered past must protect her son when a man brings trouble to her isolated bed and breakfast.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Peter Five Eight
programme.desc: Sam, a seemingly poised and glamorous real estate agent in a small mountain community is revealed to be an unhinged and troubled alcoholic with a dark secret, when a charismatic man in a black sedan named Peter shows up in town one day.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Locked In [Extended Version]
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: Juvenile

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Summer
programme.desc: Nothing screams summer more than salsa, especially chef Pino's sunshine yellow salsa served with grilled halloumi cheese. Yes, please! Next up, snappy snow peas pair with summer strawberries in a sprouted quinoa salad with Champagne vinaigrette! Pino then takes summer sunbathing to the next level, serving up blistered Shishito peppers and buttery radishes with sesame seeds and edible seaweed! For his final dish, Pino sums up summer with a French-style ratatouille served as a salad! Thinly sliced vegetables are lightly marinated before pairing with a fresh carrot purée in a dish that sparkles with summer.

programme.title: French Onion Soup
programme.desc: Onions, cheese, bread, soup, four elements that live in harmony, especially in this episode of Up the Dish! Poppy Sandler starts off in Paris - classic French Onion Soup with sweet, caramelized onions and melty Comte cheese, with perfect rounds of toasted baguette. Poppy passes it over to Micah Trainor, who doesn't miss a beat; her Tenderloin Roast with Sherry Braised Shallots is sweet, savoury, and bursting with flavour. Tiera Singh takes a chive-y dive into the vegetarian side with her Chive Pesto Pasta - don't worry, the pesto is totally customizable! Missy Hui has the showstopper, Scallion Ash Carrots and Parsnips, and it's a five-star treatment that takes the simple to spectacular! Sous-vide carrots and turnips are sprinkled with sweet-savoury scallion ash for a strangely satisfying dish.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Deadly Medicine
programme.desc: Dr. Harold 'Fred' Shipman was known as a dedicated, hardworking and community-minded doctor who spent his life gaining the trust of his patients and the respect of his colleagues. And for 25 years, nobody suspected that the town doctor was amassing a death toll that would make him one of history’s most prolific serial killers. The local undertaker is among the first to notice a strange pattern. Shipman’s patients seem to be dying at an unusually high rate, and their dead bodies had a similarity when he called to collect them – almost all were elderly women who lived alone and they died sitting in chairs while fully clothed. "There was never anything in the house that I saw that indicated the person had been ill," the undertaker remembers. "It just seems the person, where they were, had died. There was something that didn’t quite fit." Shipman is found guilty and given fifteen life sentences. A clinical audit commissioned by the Department of Health estimates Shipman is responsibility for the deaths of at least 236 patients over a 24-year period, although unofficial estimates put the number between 400 and 1,000.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death’s door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore’s symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore’s vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore’s two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some gentle lessons and soothing bedtime songs. First, Twinkle learns about the importance of eating healthy, delicious fruit, like bananas, oranges and grapes. Then, help her find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck and cow make! After a long day of learning, it's time to get ready for bed. Listen as Twinkle and Mr. Moon sing a soothing nighttime lullaby to help you relax and drift off to sleep.

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for some construction chaos and clever fixes! First, Mr. Rubble is very tired and puts the plans on the board upside down, causing the crew to build a house upside down! Then, while building a roundabout, the crew finds some big old dinosaur bones! The chaos continues as a power cut stops all their machines, so they hook everything up to clean solar panels instead. From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for playground games and construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to learn about animals, numbers, ABCs and more! Join Kii and Yii as they head to Old MacDonald's farm to learn all the sounds the animals make. Then it's time to learn numbers by singing along and counting the five cute penguins and five little ducks! The learning continues with a fun animal bus ride, a trip to space to sing 'Hey Diddle Diddle' and an important lesson on how to cross the road carefully with a mother cat and her kitten.

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate teamwork and rescue special with Kii and Yii! The adventure begins when Princess Cat is flying her plane but gets in a sticky jammy mess, causing her to lose control! It's up to Kii and Yii to get her down safely. Then, the friends are playing near Princess Cat's castle when she accidentally falls down the well and needs to be rescued again! From helping Humpty Dumpty to rounding up runaway vegetables, Kii and Yii always save the day!

programme.title: Cody Time

Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He and D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety and how a crane works. Then, they meet Frankie the Firetruck to see all of her amazing fire-fighting abilities in action! After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car and a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

programme.title: The Melon Patch
programme.desc: Discover the sense of touch with Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers! Explore fun textures like squishy, soft, and slimy. Learn how we use our sense of touch to understand the world around us, one fun squish at a time.

programme.title: The Melon Patch
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers make mealtime a delicious discovery. Through stories and songs, kids explore the joy of eating, practice mealtime routines, and learn when to use forks and spoons.

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Embark on amazing adventures! Take a wild submarine ride controlled by a lost remote and explore the four seasons with friends. Fly a rocket to the stars for a game of tag, race in a go-kart and float high in the sky with alphabet balloons!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Get your dancing shoes ready for JJ's Splashin' Jungle Jams! The party starts at the beach with a fun game of freeze dance on the sand. Then, dive deep under the sea to learn the ABCs with jellyfish and shark friends and swim like a beautiful mermaid! The adventure continues deep in the jungle where you can dance with gorillas, snakes and crocodiles. From popping bubbles to doing a silly animal dance, it's a wild party at the beach and in the jungle!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John for a collection of family sing-alongs! Be a fantastic helper for Dad at the garage, learn not to scratch bug bites, and enjoy a starry night while camping. Have a fun day at Jill's Beauty Salon with everyone.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John for a fun day at school! First, he learns that karate can be challenging, but with a lot of practice, he learns how to kick, punch and move! Then, he learns how to play soccer with the help of his big brother and sister. The day continues with a special surprise guest who drops in and teaches the gang how to play different instruments, like the piano, trumpet and guitar! It's always a fun day of learning at school!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some sci-fi mayhem with Arpo and Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel accidentally switches Arpo to zero-gravity mode, causing the robot and everything he touches to float around the city! Then, Arpo accidentally shrinks Baby Daniel with a shrink ray and has to search frantically for the tiny toddler. The out-of-this-world adventure continues when the pesky squirrel takes Daniel on an unexpected trip to outer space in a make-believe rocket!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's a day of crazy competitions and robot malfunctions! First, a friendly competition in the park turns into a wild go-kart race between Arpo and his rival, Nannybot! Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire. A toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably all over the backyard, and a malfunctioning birthday present massage chair chases him and Daniel around the house! From boomerang target practice to a building block showdown, the chaos never stops!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Get ready for some creative farm adventures with Ella! First, Ella brings school to Lellobee City Farm by creating a classroom in the Boogie Barn and teaching all her animal friends. Then, she helps Mei make some delicious jam using fresh strawberries, grapes and blueberries from the farm! The creative day ends with a magical night of stargazing, where Mei points out constellations that look just like the animals on the farm.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Join Ella for a musical day at Lellobee City Farm! Dance with a brand new tractor, help Sami with five silly monkeys, and play hide-and-seek with all the animals. Welcome the farm's newest friend, Bingo the cat, with a happy song!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Get ready to welcome some new Magic Pets with Mila and Morphle! The adventure begins when they meet Shrubcub, a pet whose power is to make plants grow, causing a huge flowery jungle to bloom in Pet Port! Then, they meet Slushyseal, who can change items into juice pops, but the friends have to stop him when he starts turning all the trees and flowers into frozen treats! From a pet that swaps bodies to one that hypnotizes animals, it's a day full of new and magical friends!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: It's a big day of trouble, all thanks to Orphle! First, he uses a Multicolour Cloner to make different colored clones of himself, and it's up to Mila and Morphle to track them all down before they cause too much chaos. Then, when the friends are playing in a cardboard castle, Orphle mistakenly thinks they don't want to play with him and attacks it! From stealing a treasure map to teaming up with Winston, Orphle is causing trouble all day!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for fun with animal friends and counting! JJ has to find five little ducks that ran away from their bath! Then, Bear helps JJ search nature to find his missing teddy bear. The animal fun continues as JJ plays hide-and-seek with shark toys, counts baby ducklings at the park and watches ten little dinosaur eggs hatch! Plus, act out the story of the 'Three Little Pigs' and sing along to 'Little Miss Muffet'!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Cody for some big moments! Go to work with Dad at the bakery, find out you're going to be a big brother, and form a rock band with your friends. Go on a safari for dinosaurs and celebrate a special Dino Birthday!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: It's a day of learning lessons at parties and games! Pogo is invited to Jeff's party, but Pogo wants it to be energetic while Jeff wants it to be calm, so they must learn to compromise. Then, Newt is desperate to win a gold star at Fuse's gym challenges, but she keeps losing! She has to learn to persevere and not give up. The lessons continue as Lulu learns to wait her turn at a funfair and Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy greens.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are learning about heroes, sharing, honesty and eating greens! When Lulu loses her favorite bunny, Bubbles comes to the rescue and becomes her personal superhero! Then, Jeff is excited to read a new book but refuses to include his friends, so he must learn the joy of sharing a story. The lessons continue as Pogo accidentally ruins Newt's teddy-shaped hedge and learns to tell the truth, and Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy Oddsprouts!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: It's time for Blippi to get curious and creative! A mysterious book appears in the clubhouse, and when Blippi opens it, the brand-new Curiosity Crew jumps out! After helping the crew figure out what they're looking for (popsicles!), Blippi and Meekah join them on some creative adventures. They learn all about how to mix colors to make a beautiful rainbow painting, shrink down to dance with Bendjamin the Klutz and ride a library cart on a hunt for books about dinosaurs!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Hop on the bus with JJ and friends, sing with the farm animals, and dance with Baby Shark! Learn about your body, find out who's eating sugar, and help Twinkle the star find her way home in this collection of favorite CoComelon hits.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to move and groove with JJ's active adventures! Ms. Appleberry teaches the importance of stretching and exercise. Then, JJ learns Taekwondo and earns his first belt! The active fun continues as the kids learn to tap dance and play on the jungle gym. Plus, join JJ and his family for a super fun beach day, making sandcastles and playing in the sea, and an exciting backyard camping trip!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join a fun sing-along play day! Ride a magic bus with real animals, celebrate Jill's birthday in a pink party bus, and play farmer at school. Get caught in a rainstorm while camping and have fun with your best pals.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns all about yummy food! First, he explores the world of vegetables and learns that they are not only delicious but also essential for staying strong and healthy. Then, the family has fun making and tasting all sorts of delicious and healthy fruit juices. The tasty adventure continues as the kids learn to make colorful popsicles with yummy fruits and Miss Hannah turns healthy fruit into fun animal faces!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble and other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably and when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Join the Minibods for an adventure with pedals, rescues and stars! Lulu goes camping but realizes she's left her favorite Binky Bunny behind and has to learn how to cope. Then, Newt goes on an adventure to find a real-life Flutterbug, but she has to be brave when her bike's stabilizers come off! The adventures continue as Jeff overcomes his fear of mud to rescue his feather duster and Bubbles builds a rocket to try and reach a big purple star in the sky!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are having a day of drawing, painting, music and a quick fix! Newt is drawing a beautiful flower but keeps rushing and crumpling her drawings, so she must learn to slow down. Then, when the Minibods help her finish a huge painting, Newt wants it all for herself! The creative chaos continues as Lulu struggles to make a music video with a marching Oddbird and Bubbles accidentally makes a mess while trying to fix a book dispenser.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for sweet dreams and goodnight songs! First, Mia giggles with delight as she gathers four of her favorite stuffed animals into bed with her for a fun game of 'Ten in the Bed.' The bedtime fun continues as Maple and Muffin play a game of 'Five Little Monkeys' during their bubble bath. Then, Grandma Panda helps Mia and Bari embark on a fantastic adventure, building a little rocket out of cushions to go on an adventure to the moon!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Drift off to sleep with these gentle bedtime songs and lullabies. Learn the alphabet in the bath, say goodnight to all the families in town and get cozy with your favorite teddy bear. This collection is perfect for a peaceful night's sleep.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of discovery and play with Twinkle and her friends! The fun starts as they learn to play new musical instruments, with Twinkle on drums, Kitty on the sax and Bunny on guitar! Then, it's time to play a fun game of 'Twinkle Says'! Follow along as they give you playful instructions and see if you can keep up. The discoveries continue as the friends find a mirror and make funny faces and wonder what an umbrella is for before it starts to rain!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Go on a magical sky adventure with Twinkle! First, discover the variety of cloud shapes and sizes, from triangles and squares to star-shaped clouds! Then, daydream high in the clouds with Twinkle and Mr. Moon, where her magical stardust makes the moon sneeze and keeps changing colors! The sky-high fun continues as Twinkle soars through the sky on a magical journey to explore all the vibrant colors of the rainbow.

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Dive into some underwater learning adventures with The Sharksons! First, join the sea friends as they swim through the alphabet to learn their ABCs. Then, explore the vibrant hues of Splashy Reef with a journey to learn all the shades of a beautiful rainbow. The learning continues with important daily routines! Sing along with Tucker the Turtle as he takes a bath and watch as Baby Grub eagerly learns the importance of dental care by brushing her big, sharp shark teeth!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest and lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, and the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation and Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley and Dazey as they face the biggest, craziest disasters! First, a big thunderstorm hits while the crew is working, and they have to rescue Scout after she gets trapped down a hole! Then, while working on a railway bridge, an earthquake causes it to almost fall apart, and the team must fix it before a train crosses! From escaping an avalanche they accidentally caused on a mountain to helping a baby lion that has escaped from the zoo, it's a day of big disasters!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: It's time to play all the best games with Kii and Yii! The fun begins with a high-stakes game of Red Light, Green Light, where Jeepbot is 'It' with a slime cannon blaster! Then, Kii and Yii play a fun game of life-size Snakes and Ladders, complete with toy snakes and big ladders. The competition continues with a game of Duck, Duck, Goose in mini race cars and a summer pool party game of Marco Polo with Snappy Croc!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to learn about animals, numbers, ABCs and more! Join Kii and Yii as they head to Old MacDonald's farm to learn all the sounds the animals make. Then it's time to learn numbers by singing along and counting the five cute penguins and five little ducks! The learning continues with a fun animal bus ride, a trip to space to sing 'Hey Diddle Diddle' and an important lesson on how to cross the road carefully with a mother cat and her kitten.

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Adventure with JJ and his animal pals! Learn to be a pirate, stop Wally Wolf from stealing a pie, and perform 'Old MacDonald' on stage. Help Boba get his lost balloon from a clock tower and put on a play of 'Hey Diddle Diddle'!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Join JJ and his animal friends on a big imagination adventure! First, Wally teaches everyone how to sail like real pirates, but they'll need to work together to stay on course! Then, when Mimi gets hungry, she decides the moon must be made of cheese, so the friends build a rocketship to fly there and find out! The adventure continues as they follow a treasure map to find special shape keys and help Little Red Riding JJ avoid Wally Wolf's silly traps in the woods.

programme.title: Lemonaidinng The Enemy
programme.desc: The Deep Fried Samurai’s burger joint is finally offering a healthy alternative: Frozen Yoghurt! – and Niya is obsessed with it. This is not just a...

programme.title: Smart Yogurt
programme.desc: Badly disguised as a bikini babe (eew!), Sensei tells Seb that there are strange goings on at the beach. Heading around the corner, Seb and Co. dis...

programme.title: The Rolling Rice Ball
programme.desc: WI-Go drops one of his rice balls in a rat hole and gets a handful of jewelry in return. Meanwhile, a greedy neighbor next door UGo hears the news.

programme.title: Stone Soup
programme.desc: WI-Go the traveler is starving and has nothing but his brain. He ends up making the most delicious soup in the world using a mysterious stone without using a single penny.

programme.title: Heungboo and Nolboo
programme.desc: Mischievous UGo takes all of his parents' property and kicks his younger brother GoGo out of the house. Meanwhile, a swallow bird brings a gourd seed to the eaves of a kind-hearted GoGo house, and soon, gourds containing gold and silver treasures opens on the roof of the GoGo's house.

programme.title: The Star Talers
programme.desc: In the cold winter, the kindhearted girl, GoGo, meets several people who feel sorry for her on her way home. A fairy queen appears in front of a GoGGo that distributes all her clothes and bread and shakes in the cold.

programme.title: Fruitful Multiplication
programme.desc: In their newly discovered subterranean dojo, four young Fruit Ninjas have been enthusiastically training against any evil their town can throw at.

programme.desc: Bolt-Ade is the newest soft drink craze. It tastes great... but the only problem is an unwanted side effect. You drink it, and then you find yourse...

programme.desc: The long, freezing winter has arrived for both the Ants, who worked hard from Spring to Autumn, and the Grasshopper, who sang and played all along.

programme.title: The Tortoise and the Hare
programme.desc: The Hare, the fastest animal in the woods, and the tortoise, the slowest, compete in a race.

programme.title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
programme.desc: The shepherd boy is bored of uneventfully peaceful days. One day, he gets an idea for a prank - to lie about seeing a wolf to his village people.

programme.title: Gold Ax and Silver Ax
programme.desc: Hardworking woodsman GoGo loses his only Ax in the pond. GoGo's cry for help summons the Mountain Spirit, who rewards for his honesty. Another greedy woodsman UGo hears the story, and heads to the pond himself.

programme.title: The Trouble With Cakes
programme.desc: Ganks Thiving arrives in the Zooniverse and Ene and Odessa search for Harolds favorite cake. They find too many cakes which begin to overflow everywhere. The friends must control the chaos and still find the perfect cake to share with Harold.

programme.title: Promis Dream
programme.desc: Odessa helps Promi remember a dream she keeps having. While exploring it she realizes that something she once thought was boring in the real world was actually enjoyable when seen differently. She learns to appreciate small moments with a new perspective.

programme.title: Opposites Attract
programme.desc: When the silly slide disappears Maple and her friends go searching for it. They discover it has been taken by the Nonicorns who are opposite versions of them. The friends must figure out how to deal with their tricky opposites and get the slide back.

programme.title: Darwins Big Air
programme.desc: Darwin wants to perform big jumps on his BMX bike so Heni and Newts help him practice. With their support he learns skills confidence and the importance of patience while improving his riding abilities.

programme.title: The Wobbly Way Home
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts take a shortcut home before dark. Using balance and teamwork they overcome obstacles along the way and learn how cooperation helps them reach safely.

programme.desc: The gang is haunted by a mystery spook and sets out to overcome their collective fear and get to the bottom of the scary mystery

programme.title: The Speed record
programme.desc: MewMew has a new stopwatch and wants to time everything that everyone does, to get to them to do it at record speed. Life in Abra-Dabra becomes intolerable as everyone tries to be quicker than the next person. Eventually Deedee and the others persuade MewMew to break all his speed records. When he achieves it no one applauds him, so MewMew realises that many things are better done in their own sweet time. He also realises that by doing everything fast, he is missing out on enjoying many things.

programme.title: Doobydoo Meep Concert
programme.desc: The annual Doobydoo Meep concert is about to take place, and Charlie wants to practice one last time before heading out. So Deedee chips in by agreeing to follow specific instructions to organise the difficult to manage Doobydoos but also promises not to use magic for anything at all. Deedee mixes up the sandwiches for the Doodyboos with the recorders that she ends up sending off with Mewmew. Nino constantly keeps Deedee in check so that she doesn’t back out of her promise. Mewmew is having a tough time organising with the Doobydoos while Deedee finds out Charlie has slept of practising. The concert goes well, but they all decide they won’t have lullabies ever again.

programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.title: Meep Meep Charlie's
programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

programme.desc: Danial dan kawan-kawannya Ayu, Bob dan Nina kembali beraksi dengan gelagat mereka yang lucu dan menarik. Berjayakah misi mereka di dalam setiap episod? Jom kita saksikannya.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Dogs are not only man's best friend, they can also serve as therapists. "Cute Pet Guide" help you train your dog to become a therapy dog. Aside from canned dog food, owners can be more attentive and prepare sumptuous meals for their pets through chef video tutorials. "Cute Pet Guide" will present you and your furry babies with exquisite dishes of love!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt has been called to the Flamingoland aquarium, to set upright some upside-down male seahorses. He diagnoses gas bubble disease, which means a delicate operation to inject drugs directly into the tiny fish's pouch.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: No wonder dogs are man's - and women's - best friend, when they give us so much to laugh about! Daft dogs, singing dogs, disobedient dogs, dogs dressed up to the canines - they're all here, obligingly caught on camera doing something hilarious.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Herchy Boal teams up with the police to attend a property near Birmingham suspected of puppy farming. Tragically, for one puppy it was already too late, but she manages to rescue another 37 including 8 expectant mothers. Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.desc: The extremly cute capybara loves massage, black-footed penguins from Africa show off their superb diving abilities, be careful cause mini pigs aren't mini in size at all, subverting your imagination towards them, and uncovering ecology of the incredible gentle giant giraffe. programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.desc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child. How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss "Cute Pet Guide"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt tackles a pet shop owner who wants to keep poisonous snakes with two-inch fangs. He undertakes an urgent biopsy on an African hornbill who is losing weight and could have a fatal condition. And it's a testing time at Flamingoland as one white rhino is shipped out and two new rhino calves are introduced to their new home.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: Talented tabbies, mischievous moggies and fabulous feline fails - they're all here, plus we're catching up with the stars of some of the web's most popular cat videos.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Alan Davies returns for a brand-new series of The Dog Rescuers and it's going to be bigger and better than ever. programme.desc: Lottie, Mint, Snap, Cheese Girl dan Mousse merupakan pastry dan gula-gula yang dihidupkan oleh seorang pembuat kek juga seorang saintis. Mereka sentiasa membantu Gloria mengatasi masalah yang dihadapi.

programme.title: Kapluk Dari Kapluwi
programme.desc: Makhluk asing yang diketuai oleh Kapluk belajar tentang bumi dari sekumpulan kanak-kanak selepas mereka tersadai di bumi kerana kapal angkasa mereka berlanggar dengan meteor.

programme.title: Dunia Kiara
programme.desc: Kiara, remaja supernatural, boleh melihat makhluk halus. Hidupnya mencabar apabila cuba membantu roh yang tidak tenang. Pada masa sama, dia terpaksa menguruskan konflik cinta dan persahabatan sekolah.

programme.title: Kau Curi Cintaku
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang isteri yang sangat baik dan suci hati. Dia terpaksa menghadapi dan mengharungi pelbagai dugaan berat serta konflik dalam kehidupan seharian serta alam perkahwinannya.

programme.title: Syahadat Cinta
programme.desc: Nasir dan Safi memujuk Sakinah membatalkan hasrat pindah ke ladang demi sekolah anak-anak. Anak-anak Sakinah juga pada mulanya tidak bersetuju selepas dimaklumkan mengenai rancangan tersebut.

programme.title: Berita Mandarin
programme.desc: Ikuti berita berbahasa Mandarin yang memaparkan perkembangan politik, sosial, ekonomi, sukan, hiburan dan isu-isu semasa.

programme.title: WORLD TODAY
programme.desc: World Today, brings you the latest news of national interest and trending international issues.

programme.title: The Write One
programme.desc: Liam guna mesin taip ajaib untuk tulis semula hidup dan masuk dunia alternatif demi lari daripada realiti. Namun, perubahan itu memaksa dia memilih antara impian atau cinta dan keluarga asalnya.

programme.title: Past Life, Present Love
programme.desc: Kisah dua insan terikat cinta kehidupan lampau. Dilahirkan semula tanpa ingatan silam, perasaan lama bangkit kembali. Hubungan yang kembali berputik ini terus diuji oleh takdir dan rahsia masa lalu.

programme.title: Family Affair
programme.desc: Keluarga Aaron dan Zu Chi musnah akibat salah faham. Usaha Sio Foo dan Mun Mun menyatukan ibu bapa mereka gagal, lalu mereka ke Gunung Impian dengan harapan kemelut keluarga itu berakhir.

programme.title: Ana Ponti
programme.desc: Ana, hantu pontianak, tekad mencari bapa kandung atau pembunuh ibunya di dunia manusia. Dia bertindak menyamar sebagai pelajar IPTA tempatan demi mempelajari cara hidup manusia.

programme.title: Food Magic
programme.desc: Rancangan ini meneroka asal-usul makanan, sains dan cerita rakyat di sebalik bahan-bahan masakan, termasuk petua orang lama, serta berkongsi tip praktikal untuk menyerlahkan rasa terbaik setiap hidangan.

programme.title: Berita Mandarin
programme.desc: Ikuti berita berbahasa Mandarin yang memaparkan perkembangan politik, sosial, ekonomi, sukan, hiburan dan isu-isu semasa.

programme.title: Diva's Secret
programme.desc: Bersama Elaine Kang menjemput tetamu yang terdiri daripada wanita yang berjaya untuk berkongsi rahsia kejayaan dan tips-tips kesihatan yang diamalkan.

programme.title: Berita Tamil
programme.desc: Berita berbahasa Tamil yang memaparkan perkembangan politik, sosial, ekonomi, sukan, hiburan dan isu-isu semasa.

programme.title: Angin Syurga
programme.desc: Wazir mengaku telah mencuri telefon bimbit dan terlepaslahtuduhan terhadap Iqbal. Ibu Mukhriz melamar Kak Long tetapi Kak Long menolak lamaran tersebut kerana mahu menjaga adik-adiknya.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: Filem mengisahkan pertelingkahan dan pergelutan diantara dua 'cult' yang berbeza iaitu Putih dan Hitam dan filem ini merupakan sekuel kepada New Kung Fu Cult Master.

programme.title: Chicago Med
programme.desc: Dr. Marcel dan Dr. Manning diculik sewaktu di luar hospital dan dipaksa merawat kaki seorang banduan yang melarikan diri.

programme.title: Family Trip
programme.desc: Menampilkan keluarga selebriti menerokai pelbagai destinasi menarik di seluruh Malaysia.

programme.title: Trilogi Cinta
programme.desc: Norjinah jadi pembantu Razif untuk lari dari bapa tirinya. Mereka kahwin atas amanah arwah isteri Razif. Walau difitnah Pak Badar dan digoda Norseha, Norjinah tabah demi rumah tangga dan cintanya.

programme.title: Wira Kasih
programme.desc: Tok Pa bernekad untuk membuka semula gelanggang silat di rumahnya. Midon meminta pertolongan isteri Tok Pa supaya dirinya diterima menjadi anak murid Tok Pa.

programme.title: Anusha
programme.desc: Drama kemasyarakatan yang memaparkan hubungan kekeluargaan , persahabatan dan percintaan.

programme.title: Agam Puram
programme.desc: Pihak polis menahan Tiben dan Swetha kerana mengesyaki mereka mungkin terlibat dengan pembunuhan Kathiravan dan bekerjasama dengan Harini untuk cuba membunuh Kannan dan Vasanthi.

programme.title: Turbulent Times
programme.desc: Kisah seorang anak muda kembali ke Malaysia selepas gagal mendapat ijazah di Korea Selatan. Melalui usaha gigih, dia berjaya mengatasi pergolakan perniagaan keluarga serta kemelut hubungan cintanya.

programme.title: My Journey With Nature

programme.title: 3D Jobs

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E68
programme.desc: Berenice reclama a Israel que nunca le haya querido lo suficiente; la abrumada mujer decreta que odia a su padre por haberle destruido la vida.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E017
programme.desc: Nicolás recibe la llamada que espera de la persona que lo va a ayudar en su venganza contra Hilario. Yosmir le pide dinero prestado a Isaura con la excusa de que es para un negocio, pero Chabeto lo pone en evidencia ante la señora asegurando que la plata es para salir con una novia, Eugenia ve su plan para salir con Yosmir desvanecerse cuando Fernanda le recuerda que tienen un compromiso en el club. Victoria se espanta al descubrir que Nicolás tenía razón, pues todos los novillos que acaba de comprar Hilario se murieron apenas el hombre cerró el trato. Jonás, manipulador, le reprocha a Antonieta que haya dudado de su amor y le muestra las fotos de todos los terrenos que ha pensado en comprar para que construyan su casa una vez que se casen.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E018
programme.desc: Hilario queda sorprendido al enterarse que Victoria ha decidido regresar a la ciudad con Hansen pues, según ella, debe ir en busca de su verdad. Nicolás asegura a Fernanda que avisarle a Victoria lo que iba a pasar con los novillos era parte de su plan para ganarse su confianza. Victoria le pide a Adelaida que le diga si es cierto que Hilario mató a Jaimito Del Casal; la señora asegura a su hija que ella cree en la inocencia de su esposo aunque Fernanda no comparta su opinión y la insta a decidir si va a creer o no en su padre. Clementina aconseja a Victoria que se busque otro enamorado que la ayude a olvidarse de Nicolás.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E115
programme.desc: Ezequiel recibe una nota de El Doliente, anticipándole su muerte. El plan contra Rosa Blanco falló. Continúa relatando los hechos del pasado; Ezequiel, obligándola a tomar el arma homicida, logró que fuera culpada por éste asesinato, por el que pagó tantos años de cárcel injusta.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E116
programme.desc: Ezequiel trata de abusar de Camila, una mano enguantada lo golpea. Todos culpan a Camila y ella se defiende diciendo que no vio al asesino. Torrealba insiste en interrogarla. Todos: Octavia, Astrid, Max, Marcelina, Leandro, Gregorio y hasta Sebastián tenían motivos para matar a Ezequiel. Sólo queda detenido Max, como presunto autor material del hecho.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E005 - Episode 5
programme.desc: Carlos Alfredo trata de humillar a Cheíto frente a sus amigos, pero sale victorioso de dicha prueba. Rosalba decide contarle a Mariana toda la verdad de su enfermedad. Abigail y Matilda llegan a la cita pero la situación se sale de control.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E006 - Episode 6
programme.desc: Matilde se encuentra en el quirófano mientras Abigail angustiada le confiesa la verdad a Freddy. Cheíto decide escribirle una carta de amor a Mariana después de verla besando a Juan Carlos. María Begoña le propone a Carlos Alfredo deshacerse de Cheíto.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E13
programme.desc: Elvis le plantea a Virginia lo del aborto. Movida por la vergüenza ante su madre y el temor a no saber cómo enfrentar un embarazo, Virginia acepta. Carmen, a pesar de los puentes que ha tendido con su hija, no logra que ésta le confíe por lo que está atravesando. Lorena se debate entre decirle toda la verdad a Marco Aurelio o seguir calando, teme por la vida de Ignacio.

Una emocionada Antonieta comenta con Fernanda que existe la posibilidad de salir en la película que va a filmar Jack aunque sea como extra, cosa que la hace muy feliz, pues todas sus amigas de la alta sociedad se van a morir de envidia.Victoria se finge furiosa ante Adelaida al recibir un ramo de flores que le envía Nicolás, aunque, a solas, admite que se muere por perdonarlo.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E020
programme.desc: Eugenia se siente incómoda cuando Miguel evidencia que gusta de ella y asegura estar dispuesto a conquistarla. Nicolás busca a Victoria en la universidad para asegurarle que está dispuesto a hacer cualquier cosa por reconquistarla, pues para él no existe más nadie; Guanipa, orgullosa, lo trata con cierto desprecio y, frente a él, llama a Builder para aceptar la invitación que le hiciera anteriormente.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E117
programme.desc: Max detenido y Camila asegura que es inocente. Santiago le cuenta al inspector haber visto a Max limpiando el objeto con el que mataron a Ezequiel y, con tristeza concluye que él y Camila fueron los autores. Continúan los interrogatorios.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E023
programme.desc: Clementina acusa sorpresa cuando Victoria le da a entender que va a darle a Builder la oportunidad de conquistarla; sin embargo, la joven Guanipa sigue añorando sus momentos de amor con Nicolás. Antonieta se aparta de Felipe pidiéndole que entienda que no debe volverla a besar porque ella es una mujer comprometida; el joven quiere hacerle entender que Jonás no la merece e intenta besarla de nuevo. A Caravaggio le parece que uno de los atractivos de Victoria es que no se deja impresionar por cualquiera, prueba de ello es que mandó a investigar a Jack; la joven se interesa en saber qué logró averiguar el periodista sobre el actor. Adelaida se conmueve al leer la nueva carta que le entrega Hilario, quien indaga qué más tiene que hacer para convencerla de lo que siente por ella.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E024
programme.desc: Nicolás se pone celoso cuando Jonás le comenta que Jack invitó a Victoria a jugar pool y que está seguro de que esa noche su amigo va a lograr besarla. Builder no se amilana ante las exigencias de Nicolás de que deje tranquila a Victoria y comienzan a discutir al punto que se caen a golpes hasta que la joven Guanipa y un mesonero los separan; Victoria le reclama a Del Casal su actitud posesiva con ella; él la besa con pasión para demostrarle qué le da derecho a sentirse así. Eugenia llama a Yosmir para darle las gracias por la torta que le llevó cuando fue a visitarla; él aparte de reprocharle la forma en que lo trató frente a Fernanda, le dice lo que piensa de toda su familia logrando molestarla. Fernanda recibe una nota anónima donde le advierten que la estafa a Cantarrana no se va a quedar así y ella pagará por eso. Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que está corriendo peligro, pero le asegura que él la va a proteger.

programme.desc: Small errors in the construction of buildings and vehicles can lead to a disaster. Top aviation experts share their theories about the mysterious whereabouts and final fate of Malaysia Airlines MH370.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E92 - Superpredators
programme.desc: For thousands—or even millions—of years, they ruled the food chain. And they still fascinate us. Creatures synonymous with the hunt: Saber Teeth, Mega Jaws, even a Tyrant King. How did they win evolution’s race—and what brought their reign to an end?

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E01 - Science On Fire
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they kindle our curiosity about the science behind fire. This week’s experiments investigate how you can burn metal using only a 9 volt battery, what fire can teach us about calories, and why a little bit of sodium can cause a gigantic explosion.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E02 - Invisible Impacts
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they shine a light on the unseen science behind our everyday lives. This week’s experiments explore the resonant frequencies of bridges and human bodies.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E03 - Water Water Everywhere
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they dive deep into the wonderful world of water. In this week’s experiments we discover how water can start a fire, transform breakfast cereal into a magnetic field detector, and even change the way you visualize the world around you.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E05 - Up and Atom
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they break open the atomic bonds that connect our world. This week’s experiments blow open the science behind creating a glowing pickle, how forensic teams extract DNA, and how acids can transform simple household items to their core.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E90 - Brain-Computer Interface: The Digital Mind
programme.desc: This is an inside look at how teams of scientists, engineers and surgeons—and their courageous test subjects—are using Brain-Computer Interfaces to bring hope and increased independence to patients living with conditions like paralysis, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and blindness.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E03 - The Secret Lives of Pumas
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Pumas are also known by the names of cougar or mountain lion. However, these cats are only distantly related to lions. They're much more closely related to cheetahs. And while pumas are often found in mountains, they're just as at home in the lowlands, dense forests, treeless pampers, or deserts.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E04 - The Secret Lives of Lions
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Lions differ from all other cats in that they are highly social, forming prides of up to 35 animals. There are now thought to be fewer than 15,000 lions remaining in Kenya's Masai Mara, a drop of 75% in 50 years.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E06 - The Secret Lives of Jaguars
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. The first jaguar scientists struggled to go anywhere near their subjects.
